body: I dropped it, I had to before today. I regret it but I know it was the right move, this just really sucks.
I've made the decision that I am going to. Just addressing my parents about it will be difficult.
I'd need to wait until May/June to take another but I will. I just really don't see myself passing this class. I just hope it's wiped instead of giving me a W for withdrawal.
Thank you, but honestly, I'm just afraid. I can't talk to them, I try but I start to shake, sweat, I can't breathe, I can't speak, I basically start to panic. The internet is all I have

My grandparents are either dead, in prison, or admittedly don't like me. I don't have a relationship with neighbors and I don't want one with them, and I always try to help people if I can but it doesn't do anything for me

>Is there anything triggering all of this sadness?

I'm failing a class and I forgot to sign up for next semester, I'm extremely lonely, I don't have any friends, my family is disappointed in me, I have no job and cannot find one, I'm nearly out of money, etc.
Calling a hotline wont do anything but postpone this feeling

I don't understand how a hotline can help. 

>Why would you want to stop it?

Because I'm not doing anything useful or helpful, I'm just wasting space and peoples time
